meanings.usage: 指官方的新闻报道或公告信息
指在电视或广播中播报新闻的人
指意大利通心粉，是一种意大利面食
指从事农作物种植的人
用于形容质量、状况或外观非常好

meanings.meaning: 收成（指农作物的收割季节或收获量） verb. 收获

meanings.usage: 指用机械或手工方法使谷物脱离秸秆
指对原材料进行加工处理使其变成产品
指多人参与的争夺名次的活动
指比赛或竞赛中的获胜者
指将分散的东西集中在一起
用于形容在某一领域最重要或最成功的
指负责管理某企业或部门的人

phrases.usage: 转向；切换到，指新闻报道中切换到另一个地点或话题

examples.en: We're going over to the macaroni fields of Calabria.
examples.zh: 我们现在转向意大利卡拉布里亚的通心粉田地。

examples.en: Let's go over to our correspondent in Beijing.
examples.zh: 让我们切换到在北京的记者。

phrases.usage: 日夜不停地；夜以继日，形容持续不断的工作或活动

examples.en: The whole village has been working day and night.
examples.zh: 整个村子一直在日夜不停地工作。

examples.en: She studied day and night before the exam.
examples.zh: 考试前她夜以继日地学习。

phrases.usage: 他们两个一起；总共，用于指两个人共同完成某事

examples.en: Two workers who, between them, have just finished cutting three cartloads.
examples.zh: 两个工人，他们一起刚割完三车的通心粉茎。

examples.en: Between them, they have visited over 50 countries.
examples.zh: 他们两个总共访问了50多个国家。

phrases.usage: 自...以来每一年，表示从过去某时起每年都发生的动作

examples.en: He has won it every year since 1991.
examples.zh: 自1991年以来他每年都赢得比赛。

examples.en: She has called me every year since we graduated.
examples.zh: 自我们毕业以来她每年都给我打电话。

phrases.usage: 收割满车的...，表示收获大量的农作物

examples.en: They have just finished cutting three cartloads of golden brown macaroni stalks.
examples.zh: 他们刚收割完三车金黄色的通心粉茎。

phrases.usage: 帮助某人...时间，表示持续帮助的时长

examples.en: She has been helping her husband for thirty years now.
examples.zh: 她帮丈夫干活到现在已经三十年了。

examples.en: He has been helping his father in the shop for five years.
examples.zh: 他在店里帮父亲干活已经五年了。

phrases.usage: 收获结束时；收割的尾声

examples.en: This shows you what will happen at the end of the harvest.
examples.zh: 这向你展示收获结束时会发生什么。

phrases.usage: 将要；打算，表示将来的计划或即将发生的事

examples.en: We're going over to the macaroni fields.
examples.zh: 我们将去通心粉田地。

examples.en: We're now going back to the studio.
examples.zh: 我们现在要回到演播室。

phrases.usage: 比往常早，表示比正常时间提前

examples.en: Harvesting has begun earlier than usual.
examples.zh: 收割比往常开始得更早。

grammar.title: 现在完成进行时 (Present Perfect Continuous)
grammar.structure: 主语 + have/has + been + 动词-ing
grammar.definition: 表示一个动作从过去开始，一直持续到现在，并且可能继续下去。强调动作的持续性。 用于描述持续性的动作，常与 for + 时间段、since + 时间点、all + 时间段等时间状语连用。

examples.en: They have been expecting a splendid crop this year.
examples.zh: 他们一直期待着今年有个好收成。

examples.en: She has been helping her husband for thirty years.
examples.zh: 她帮丈夫干活已经三十年了。

examples.en: The whole village has been working day and night.
examples.zh: 整个村子一直在日夜不停地工作。

grammar.title: 时间状语 since 和 for 的用法
grammar.structure: since + 过去时间点/过去发生的动作；for + 一段时间
grammar.definition: since 表示从过去的某一时间点开始，for 表示一段时间。两者都可与现在完成时连用。 since 后接具体时间点或从句，for 后接表示时间长度的词。

examples.en: Macaroni has been grown in this area for over six hundred years.
examples.zh: 这个地区种植通心粉已有六百多年。

examples.en: He has won it every year since 1991.
examples.zh: 自1991年以来他每年都赢得比赛。

examples.en: She has been helping her husband for thirty years now.
examples.zh: 她帮丈夫干活到现在已经三十年了。

grammar.title: 关系代词 who 引导的定语从句
grammar.structure: 先行词 + who + 谓语动词 + 其他成分
grammar.definition: who 是关系代词，用于指人，在定语从句中作主语，先行词通常是人。 用来修饰前面的名词或代词，提供额外信息。who 在从句中代替先行词并在从句中担任成分。

examples.en: Here you can see two workers who, between them, have just finished cutting three cartloads.
examples.zh: 在这里你可以看到两个工人，他们一起刚割完三车的通心粉茎。

examples.en: Signor Fratelli, the present champion, has won it every year since 1991.
examples.zh: 弗拉特利先生，现任冠军，自1991年以来每年都赢得比赛。

patterns.pattern: We're going over to + 地点/话题

original.en: We're going over to the macaroni fields of Calabria.
original.zh: 我们现在转向意大利卡拉布里亚的通心粉田地。

imitations.en: We're going over to our London studio.
imitations.zh: 我们现在切换到伦敦演播室。

imitations.en: We're going over to see what happened at the scene.
imitations.zh: 我们现在转到现场看看发生了什么。

patterns.pattern: 主语 + have/has been + doing sth. + for/since + 时间

original.en: She has been helping her husband for thirty years now.
original.zh: 她帮丈夫干活到现在已经三十年了。

imitations.en: He has been learning English for five years.
They have been waiting for you since 9 o'clock.
imitations.zh: 他们从九点起就一直在等你。

patterns.pattern: Here you can see + 主语 + doing sth.

original.en: Here you can see two workers who have just finished cutting.
original.zh: 在这里你可以看到两个刚完成收割的工人。

imitations.en: Here you can see students who have been studying all night.
imitations.zh: 在这里你可以看到整晚一直在学习的学生们。

imitations.en: Here you can see farmers who are harvesting crops.
imitations.zh: 在这里你可以看到正在收割农作物的农民们。

patterns.pattern: 主语 + has won it every year since + 年份

original.en: Signor Fratelli has won it every year since 1991.
original.zh: 弗拉特利先生自1991年以来每年都赢得比赛。

imitations.en: She has been the class monitor every year since 2020.
imitations.zh: 她自2020年以来每年都是班长。

imitations.en: He has taken first prize every year since he joined the club.
imitations.zh: 自他加入俱乐部以来他每年都拿一等奖。

lines.en: 'To end our special news bulletin ,' said the voice of the television announcer , 'we're going over to the macaroni fields of Calabria.
lines.zh: “作为我们专题新闻节目的结尾，”电视广播员说，“我们现在到克拉布利亚的通心粉田里。

lines.en: Macaroni has been grown in this area for over six hundred years.
lines.zh: 通心粉在这个地区已经种植了600多年了。两个主要种植者，朱塞皮。

lines.en: Two of the leading growers, Giuseppe Moldova and Riccardo Brabante, tell me that they have been expecting a splendid crop this year and harvesting has begun earlier than usual.
Here you can see two workers who, between them, have just finished cutting three cartloads of golden brown macaroni stalks .
lines.zh: 布拉班特告诉我，他们一直期待着今年获得一个大丰收，收割工作比往年开始要早些。

lines.en: The whole village has been working day and night gathering and threshing this year's crop before the September rains.
lines.zh: 这里您可以看到两个工人，他们协力割下了3车金黄色的通心粉秸。

lines.en: On the right, you can see Mrs.. Brabante herself.
lines.zh: 全村的人都日夜奋战，要赶在9月的雨季之前把今年的庄稼收获上来，打完场。

lines.en: She has been helping her husband for thirty years now.
lines.zh: 在屏幕的右侧，您可以看到布拉班特太太本人，她已经帮了她的丈夫30年了。

lines.en: Mrs.. Brabante is talking to the manager of the local factory where the crop is processed.
lines.zh: 布拉班特太太现在正和负责通心粉加工的当地加工厂的经理交谈。

lines.en: This last scene shows you what will happen at the end of the harvest: the famous Calabrian macaroni-eating competition!
lines.zh: 这最后一个镜头向您展示了收获之后将发生的事情：著名的克拉布利亚人吃通心粉大赛！

lines.en: Signor Fratelli, the present champion, has won it every year since 1991.
lines.zh: 目前的冠军弗拉特里先生，自1991年以来，年年获胜。

lines.en: And that ends our special bulletin for today, Thursday, April lst.
lines.zh: 今天--4月1日，星期四--的专题新闻节目到此结束。

lines.en: We're now going back to the studio
lines.zh: 现在我们回到电视演播室。”

questions.a: The joke was that the television bulletin pretended macaroni was a crop grown in fields in Calabria — with growers, golden brown stalks, harvesting, threshing and an eating competition — and broadcast it on Thursday, April 1st as if it were real news.
questions.aZh: 玩笑在于：这则4月1日的“专题新闻”装作通心粉是长在克拉布利亚田里的庄稼，煞有介事地报道种植者、通心粉秸、收割打场和吃通心粉大赛。
questions.hint: 见首句 “we're going over to the macaroni fields of Calabria” 与结尾播出日期。

questions.q: How long has macaroni been grown in this area, and why has harvesting begun earlier than usual?
questions.zh: 通心粉在这一地区已种植多久？为什么收割比往年开始得早？
questions.a: It has been grown there for over six hundred years, and harvesting has begun earlier than usual because the growers have been expecting a splendid crop this year.
questions.aZh: 已经种了六百多年；因为两位主要种植者一直盼着今年有个大丰收，收割工作比往年开始得早。
questions.hint: 见 has been grown... for over six hundred years 与 have been expecting。

questions.q: What have the two workers and the whole village been doing, and why is there a time limit?
questions.zh: 两名工人和全村的人都在做什么？为什么要赶时间？
questions.a: Between them the two workers have just finished cutting three cartloads of golden brown macaroni stalks, and the whole village has been working day and night gathering and threshing this year's crop, because they must finish before the September rains.
questions.aZh: 两名工人合力刚割完三车金黄色的通心粉秸；全村日夜不停地收割、打场，因为必须赶在九月雨季之前干完。
questions.hint: 见 between them、three cartloads 与 before the September rains。

questions.q: Who is Signor Fratelli and what is he famous for?
questions.zh: 弗拉特里先生是谁？他以什么出名？
questions.a: He is the present champion of the famous Calabrian macaroni-eating competition and has won it every year since 1991.
questions.aZh: 他是著名的克拉布利亚吃通心粉大赛的现任冠军，自1991年以来年年获胜。
questions.hint: 见 the famous Calabrian macaroni-eating competition 与 since 1991。

questions.q: Why did the bulletin sound so convincing, and where is the real clue that it was a joke?
questions.zh: 为什么这则新闻听起来像真的？真正的破绽在哪里？
questions.a: It copied the style of a real report: a serious announcer, real-sounding names, places and figures. The clue is the closing date — Thursday, April 1st, April Fools' Day — and the impossible idea of macaroni fields.
questions.aZh: 它完全模仿真正的新闻：严肃的播音员、像模像样的人名地名和数字。真正的破绽在结尾的播出日期——4月1日星期四，愚人节；通心粉根本不可能长在田里。
questions.hint: 留意结尾 Thursday, April 1st 与首句 macaroni fields 之间的矛盾。

translation:
“作为我们专题新闻节目的结尾，”电视广播员说，“我们现在到克拉布利亚的通心粉田里。
通心粉在这个地区已经种植了600多年了。
两个主要种植者，朱塞皮。
莫尔道瓦和里卡多。
布拉班特告诉我，他们一直期待着今年获得一个大丰收，收割工作比往年开始要早些。
这里您可以看到两个工人，他们协力割下了3车金黄色的通心粉秸。
全村的人都日夜奋战，要赶在9月的雨季之前把今年的庄稼收获上来，打完场。
在屏幕的右侧，您可以看到布拉班特太太本人，她已经帮了她的丈夫30年了。
布拉班特太太现在正和负责通心粉加工的当地加工厂的经理交谈。
这最后一个镜头向您展示了收获之后将发生的事情：著名的克拉布利亚人吃通心粉大赛！
目前的冠军弗拉特里先生，自1991年以来，年年获胜。
今天--4月1日，星期四--的专题新闻节目到此结束。
现在我们回到电视演播室。”
title: April Fools' Day
subtitle: 愚人节

lead.question: 这则“专题新闻”说通心粉长在地里，它到底想开谁的玩笑？
lead.warmup: 每年4月1日，英美媒体都会一本正经地播报一条假新闻，等着有人上当。本课正是这样一则“专题新闻”：播音员用严肃的口吻把通心粉说成种在地里的庄稼，还报出地名、人名和年份。请注意，越是煞有介事的数字和细节，越可能是陷阱：先看播出日期，再判断真假。
goals: 听懂并复述这则4月1日的“假新闻”，指出玩笑在于把通心粉说成种在地里的庄稼
掌握 bulletin、announcer、grower、stalk、thresh、process、champion、studio 等新闻与农事词汇
区分现在完成进行时（have been expecting / working）与现在完成时被动（has been grown）
学会用 no less than、cartload、between them 表达数量与“协力”
lead.summary: 本文是一则4月1日的“专题新闻”：播音员煞有介事地报道克拉布利亚的“通心粉田”——已种六百多年、两位主要种植者盼着大丰收、工人割下三车金色通心粉秸、全村日夜收割打场、吃通心粉大赛冠军年年卫冕，末句“回到演播室”点明这只是一个玩笑。
lead.tips: 辨真假的诀窍是先看时间与常识：结尾的 “Thursday, April 1st” 就是破绽；且 macaroni 是加工过的面粉，不可能与 fields 连用。

exercises.q: 用 fool 的适当形式填空：On April _______ Day people try to _______ their friends, and this news bulletin _______ its viewers into believing that macaroni grows in fields.
exercises.note: fool 名动两用，后接 into doing。

exercises.q: 据课文填空：'To end our special news _______ ,' said the voice of the television _______ . When the programme was _______ , they went back to the _______ .
exercises.note: be over 表结束；studio 演播室。

exercises.q: 用括号中动词的正确形式填空：Macaroni has _______ (grow) in this area for over six hundred years, and the growers have been _______ (expect) a splendid crop this year.
exercises.note: 被动表持续状态，完成进行表持续动作。

exercises.q: 填空：Two of the _______ (首要的) growers, Giuseppe Moldova and Riccardo Brabante, tell me they have been expecting a _______ (极好的) crop this year.
exercises.note: leading 首要的；splendid 极好的。

exercises.q: 用 begin doing 结构改写句子：Harvesting has begun earlier than usual.
exercises.a: They have begun harvesting earlier than usual.
exercises.note: begin doing 表开始做某事。

exercises.q: 翻译句子：这两个工人协力割下的金黄色通心粉秸足有三车。
exercises.a: The two workers, between them, have just finished cutting no less than three cartloads of golden brown macaroni stalks.
exercises.note: cartload 车载量；between them 表协力。

exercises.q: 综合填空：The whole village has been working day and night _______ (gather) and _______ (thresh) the crop; the growers _______ a busy _______ (过着忙碌的生活) at harvest time. The crop is _______ (加工) in the local factory, and the _______ (目前的) champion has won the competition every year since 1991.
exercises.a: gathering; threshing; lead; life; processed; present
exercises.note: lead a busy life；be processed 被加工。

quiz.q: 这则新闻说，通心粉在克拉布利亚地区已经种植了多久？
options: For over six hundred years
For over sixty years
For thirty years
Since 1991
quiz.note: 原句为 for over six hundred years。

quiz.q: 课文中 “between them” 是什么意思？
options: In turns, one after another
Against each other
As a result of their joint effort
Between the two fields
quiz.note: between them 表“由于共同努力、协力”。

quiz.q: 全村的人为什么日夜不停地干活？
options: They are building a new processing factory
They must gather and thresh the crop before the September rains
They are waiting for the television announcer
They want to go back to the studio

quiz.q: 关于弗拉特里先生，下列哪一项正确？
options: He is the manager of the local factory
He has been helping his wife for thirty years
He is one of the leading growers in Calabria
He is the present champion and has won it every year since 1991

quiz.q: “Macaroni has been grown in this area for over six hundred years.” 属于哪种时态和语态？
options: The present perfect continuous
The simple past passive
The present perfect passive
The past perfect passive

quiz.q: 下列哪一项最能证明这是一条愚人节的玩笑？
options: The announcer spoke in a serious voice
It was broadcast on Thursday, April 1st
The village was in Calabria
The champion had won it since 1991
quiz.note: 播出日期4月1日即愚人节。
